research_notes: Blocked: after first speech, official/party biographies, election profiles and targeted employer/date/FTE searches, commercial firm's identity, organic business interval, actual UN appointment and substantive hours remain unresolved.
2020–2023 Greenpeace dates follow frozen official occupation record; vague secondary post-2019-election language does not justify changing start to2019.
Parents' farm/teaching careers and full-time job advertisements for her parliamentary staff are not her employment evidence. Unknown headline years remain null, not zero.

Follow-up2026-10-02: added self-confirmed Di Natale political work omitted from initial timeline; employer press release provides dated Greenpeace observation30 October2020; AMA narrows UN research to Gillard/Rudd and Security Council campaign context.

Searched legal-firm identity, organic business, UN mission archive and nonprofit records. ABR name-match entry does not identify organic business or establish actual work dates, so registration dates not used. Crikey2016 statement is a reader letter and not silently promoted to verified reported chronology.

Follow-up2026-10-03: interview-based Guardian reporting identifies previously omitted AusAID work on climate, food security and the Pacific and clarifies the New York function as support negotiator for Australia's positions. AusAID is retained as a separate unresolved spell because the source names the agency, but it may overlap the Mission assignment; payroll status, dates, hours and public-service appointment remain unknown. Repeated business-name and legal-employer searches did not resolve those identities.

Next leads: Di Natale archived office staffing/role biography; UN mission internship/adviser appointment record;2009 legal firm and later environmental-law employment identity; organic business trading name and ownership documents. No outreach or authenticated collection; dates/FTE still unknown.

Follow-up2026-10-04: a primary ABC court report quotes Hodgins-May calling her late father Rod May her business partner and identifies him as a Blampied farmer. This adds a previously omitted family-farming business relationship. The report supplies no legal entity, start date, pay, ownership share or hours; it is not silently merged with the separately recorded unidentified organic-food founder role. Her father's2017 death is context, not an inferred business-cessation date.
